routines.name: string_set_find
routines.scope: NUL-terminated search-set membership, first-match indexing, no-match length, repeated/high-bit bytes, and both RAM aliases.

routines.name: ascii_name_hash
routines.scope: Seeded ASCII-case-insensitive byte-sum hash across empty, upper/lower, high-bit and deterministic strings under both aliases.

routines.name: directory_entry_parse
routines.scope: Rejected record lengths, ordinary file names, directory flags, . and .. special-name normalization, return values and full bounded output memory comparison.

limitations: Malformed records with name lengths below two and the flag-clear path can wrap the native copy count and write address; malformed-pointer exception behavior is excluded.
